2b07b22529989225.description: البيانات الأساسية المسمى الوظيفي: مسؤول سلامة وصحة مهنية (HSE Officer). موقع العمل: مدينة الصناعة والأعمال – مصنع المواسير الخرسانية. القطاع: الصناعة والتصنيع – المنتجات الخرسانية. نوع العمل: دوام كامل. المهام والمسؤوليات تطبيق ومتابعة سياسات وإجراءات السلامة والصحة المهنية داخل المصنع، والتأكد من الالتزام بالأنظمة والاشتراطات المعتمدة. إجراء الجولات التفتيشية الدورية على خطوط الإنتاج ومناطق التشغيل والتخزين والتحميل، ورصد المخاطر والممارسات غير الآمنة ومتابعة معالجتها. إعداد ومراجعة تقييمات المخاطر وتحليل سلامة المهام (Risk Assessment / JSA)، واقتراح إجراءات التحكم والوقاية المناسبة. مراقبة تطبيق اشتراطات السلامة أثناء عمليات خلط الخرسانة والصب وفك القوالب والمعالجة ونقل المواسير الخرسانية ومناولتها. التحقق من سلامة عمليات الرفع والتحميل والتفريغ باستخدام الأوناش والرافعات الشوكية ومعدات المناولة، والتأكد من صلاحية معدات وأدوات الرفع واتباع إجراءات التشغيل الآمن. متابعة تطبيق إجراءات التخزين الآمن للمواسير الخرسانية والمنتجات الثقيلة، ومنع مخاطر السقوط والتدحرج والانهيار. التحقق من وجود وسائل حماية الآلات والأجزاء المتحركة، وتطبيق إجراءات عزل مصادر الطاقة (LOTO) أثناء أعمال الصيانة والتنظيف والتدخلات الفنية. متابعة إجراءات الوقاية من المخاطر المهنية المرتبطة بالغبار الأسمنتي والسيليكا والضوضاء والحرارة والمواد الكيميائية المستخدمة في الإنتاج. التأكد من التزام العاملين باستخدام معدات الوقاية الشخصية (PPE)، وتنفيذ برامج التوعية والتدريب واجتماعات السلامة الدورية. المشاركة في التحقيق في الحوادث والإصابات والحوادث الوشيكة (Near Misses)، وتحليل أسبابها الجذرية، ومتابعة تنفيذ الإجراءات التصحيحية والوقائية. متابعة جاهزية خطط الطوارئ والإخلاء ووسائل مكافحة الحريق والإسعافات الأولية، والمشاركة في تنفيذ تدريبات الطوارئ. إعداد تقارير السلامة اليومية والدورية، وتوثيق الملاحظات والمخالفات والإجراءات التصحيحية، والتنسيق مع إدارة المصنع والصيانة والإنتاج لمعالجة المخاطر. المؤهلات والمتطلبات دبلوم أو بكالوريوس في السلامة والصحة المهنية أو أحد التخصصات ذات الصلة. خبرة عملية في مجال السلامة والصحة المهنية، ويفضل أن تكون في المصانع أو المنشآت الصناعية، وبالأخص مصانع الخرسانة أو المنتجات الأسمنتية. الإلمام بالأنظمة واللوائح السعودية المتعلقة بالسلامة والصحة المهنية ومتطلبات السلامة الصناعية. خبرة عملية في تقييم المخاطر والتفتيش الميداني والتحقيق في الحوادث وإعداد تقارير السلامة. المعرفة بإجراءات السلامة الخاصة بالآلات الصناعية والمعدات الثقيلة والرافعات وعمليات الرفع والتخزين. الإلمام بإجراءات العزل والتحكم بالطاقة (LOTO) وتصاريح العمل (PTW). امتلاك التأهيل أو الاعتماد المهني المطلوب نظامًا لشغل الوظيفة، بحسب التصنيف المهني ومتطلبات الجهات المختصة. يفضل الحصول على شهادات مهنية مثل NEBOSH IGC أو OSHA أو IOSH. إجادة استخدام برامج Microsoft Office وإعداد التقارير. إجادة اللغة الإنجليزية بالمستوى المناسب لمتطلبات العمل.

2b2afc445ddbbcf5.description: About the Role King Abdullah bin Abdulaziz University Hospital in Riyadh is seeking a Plastic & Reconstructive Surgery Assistant Consultant to provide comprehensive medical services within their specialty and privileges. This full-time role involves contributing to clinical, administrative, educational, and research initiatives at the hospital. Clinical Responsibilities Assist Consultants in clinical work by providing patient care in accordance with the delineated scope of services and granted privileges. Deliver patient care across various settings including outpatient clinics, inpatient wards, emergency room, operating room, day unit, and intensive care units. Perform consultation services, follow-up care, procedures, and participate in on-call duties as assigned. Practice patient care based on scientific evidence and up-to-date best practices. Adhere to KAAUH quality improvement initiatives and practices, ensuring a safe healing environment and compliance with hospital accreditation requirements. Empower patients and their families to actively participate in their health and wellness, contributing to an excellent patient experience. Demonstrate accountability, appropriate resource utilization, and focus on efficient patient care processes. Supervise residents, contribute to their professional development, and provide feedback on performance evaluations. Administrative Contributions Undertake administrative duties related to patient care, such as developing Clinical Management Guidelines, Clinical Pathways, and Evidence-Based Best Practices. Contribute to quality assurance and improvement through activities like Audits, Peer Reviews, and Morbidity & Mortality Rounds. Fulfill administrative requirements for the development of the division, department, executive department, or hospital, including procurement, staff recruitment, manpower planning, policy development, process improvement, and committee participation. Education and Research Engagement Participate in general undergraduate and post-graduate teaching activities. Provide regular teaching to all team members appropriate to their level. Engage in departmental educational activities such as Grand Rounds, Journal Club, and daily morning meetings. Utilize continuing professional development events at KAAUH and maintain CME recertification requirements. Possess the necessary knowledge to conduct scientific research. Participate in departmental and hospital research activities, working towards scientific publications. Professional Conduct and Values Demonstrate a practical understanding of KAAUH Mission, Vision, Values, Bylaws, Code of Ethics, Code of Professional Conduct, and all job-related Policies and Procedures. Uphold KAAUH values: Patient-Driven, High Reliability, Teamwork, Professional Ethics, Learning and Sharing, and Performance-Driven. Provide patient/family education related to health learning needs. Respect patients and their families to promote a patient-centered care culture. Participate in and support quality improvement and patient safety activities. Additional Duties The Assistant Consultant will perform other related duties as required to support the department and hospital operations.

2b6c4769a29815f8.description: About the Role KAUST (King Abdullah University of Science and Technology) is seeking an Associate Director of Student Affairs to join its team in Thuwal, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time leadership position is responsible for overseeing multiple critical student support services, ensuring a supportive and inclusive environment that fosters both personal and academic success for students. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement a strategic vision for Student Affairs that aligns with the University's mission and enhances the holistic development and well-being of students. Provide leadership and guidance to units within Student Affairs, including Student Counseling Services, Student Life, English Language and Communication Programs, Disability Support, and Student Conduct. Foster collaboration among different Student Affairs units and academic programs to integrate support services seamlessly into the student experience. Develop, review, and enforce policies related to student conduct, mental health services, and other areas, ensuring compliance with national regulations, international standards, and University values. Collaborate with unit heads to design, implement, and evaluate programs that meet the diverse needs of students. Establish and manage comprehensive crisis management protocols for student emergencies, coordinating with relevant University departments. Manage the student conduct process, providing support to the Director of Admissions and Student Affairs and the Student Conduct panel. Act as the primary point of contact with the Graduate Students Council, supporting their governance and activities. Manage and oversee the budget for the Student Affairs department, ensuring fiscal responsibility and alignment with the strategic plan. Collect, analyze, and report data on the effectiveness of Student Affairs programs to inform decision-making and continuous improvement. Oversee the recruitment, training, and professional development of staff within the Student Affairs department. Serve as an advocate for student well-being, providing support and guidance for students in need, and ensuring access to appropriate resources. Oversee the planning and execution of orientation for new students, ensuring a smooth transition into university life. Ensure the effective promotion of services to maximize student engagement, well-being, and academic and social success on campus. Represent the Student Affairs department, providing critical information and feedback on student experience matters. Additional Duties Oversee administration of confidential records and information. Coordinate student referrals to community practitioners and partners. Support and assist divisional and University objectives and programs as appropriate. Participate in the overall mandate of the Division by attending staff meetings, serving on committees, and representing the Division and University as requested. Perform other duties within the range of skills normally associated with this type of position, as required by the Director of Admissions and Student Affairs. Qualifications and Experience Candidates for this role should possess over 10 years of relevant experience in student affairs or a related field, demonstrating strong leadership and administrative capabilities within a higher education setting. Work Environment This is a full-time position based at the KAUST campus in Thuwal, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. The role involves working within a dynamic university environment, collaborating with various departments and student bodies to enhance the overall student experience.

2b76e423b06941e4.description: About PepsiCo PepsiCo is a global leader in beverages and convenient foods, with products enjoyed by consumers worldwide. The company generated over $79 billion in net revenue in 2021, driven by a portfolio that includes brands such as LAY’S®, DORITOS®, CHEETOS®, GATORADE®, PEPSI®, and QUAKER®. PepsiCo operates with a vision to be a global leader by Winning with PepsiCo Positive (pep+), a strategic transformation focused on sustainability and human capital. The Role of Sr. Merchandiser PepsiCo is seeking a Sr. Merchandiser to join its sales team in Khamis Harb, Makkah, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role is central to maximizing the on-shelf presence of PepsiCo products in all assigned outlets. The Sr. Merchandiser will ensure adherence to planograms for both on-shelf and off-shelf displays and will be responsible for reporting any non-compliance. Additionally, the role involves gathering and supplying market information to pre-sellers to identify and leverage selling opportunities. Key Responsibilities Call on specific OT outlets according to the daily journey plan provided by the supervisor. Merchandise SSFL products within OT stores across various access points, including shelves, stands, and floor displays. Place Point of Sale (POS) material next to SSFL displays as applicable. Ensure all access points are merchandised in adherence to approved planograms. Rotate products using the FIFO (First-In, First-Out) method and remove sub-standard products. Maintain clean and fresh stock of SSF products on the shelf at all times. Monitor and report competitive activities in the market. Report any deviations from agreed terms with assigned OT customers or outlets. Provide daily activity reports for the prior day to the supervisor. Participate in sampling and redemption campaigns when required. Maintain a professional personal appearance and behavior in line with the Frito Lay code of conduct. Performance Measures Performance in this role will be evaluated based on several key indicators: Execution Standard. LTA enforcement. Journey plan adherence. Work Environment and Culture PepsiCo fosters a dynamic and collaborative culture driven by passionate teams. The company is committed to creating a diverse, equitable, and inclusive environment where all employees have a voice. Associates are encouraged to embrace new ideas and contribute to a flourishing workplace and society.

2b9b33ad0f0fc7fb.description: About the Role Denodo is seeking a Sales Director to manage and execute direct sales within the assigned region. This is a full-time, individual contributor sales opportunity based in Al Dar Al Baida District, Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role focuses on driving revenue through direct and indirect channels, with a strong emphasis on new customer acquisition and strategic sales planning. Key Responsibilities Develop, maintain, and manage the implementation of strategic sales plans for the assigned territory. Manage efforts to research and identify customer prospects and targets. Meet individual sales quotas based on corporate and regional revenue targets. Achieve new customer acquisition targets and implement expansion strategies. Work with partner channels sales teams to identify, source, and onboard appropriate channel and alliance partners, driving revenue through both direct and indirect channels. Set and execute customer acquisition strategy across direct inbound and through the partner ecosystem within assigned accounts and/or territory. Develop and actively maintain sales forecasts across assigned accounts and territory. Measure and report the results of sales and plan execution. Required Qualifications and Experience Over 10 years of experience in sales. A track record of exceeding sales targets in enterprise software over the past five years. Solid background in data integration, data analytics, and data management. Proven experience engaging with potential customers, partners, and prospects in the assigned region. Skills and Attributes Excellent presentation and communication skills. Ability to manage the entire sales process from business development, prospecting, and qualifying to negotiations and closing. Work Environment The successful candidate will work closely with experienced sales and marketing leadership and be supported by a strong technical team. This role is within a fast-paced and rapidly growing company, offering opportunities for professional development and excellence.

2bba305de47b44d8.description: About the Role International Maritime Industries is seeking an Engineer Methods Structural & Lifting to join their team in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia. This full-time role involves preparing and reviewing design analyses, calculations, and procedures for various structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard environment. The incumbent will ensure the safety, efficiency, and reliability of critical engineering operations, focusing on both in-service and pre-service analyses. Key Responsibilities Prepare and review design analyses, calculations, and procedures for structural in-service and pre-service engineering deliverables, including hull structure design, transportation, lifting, installation, vessel deck layout and modification, hull structure erection, and ship lift. Demonstrate familiarity with project scope of work, specifications, schedule, and inter-discipline requirements, proactively identifying and addressing concerns. Interface with other departments to gather necessary input for discipline designs and drawings. Maintain close coordination with various disciplines and entities such as Engineering, Project Management Team, Procurement, Fabrication, and Construction. Assist in preparing estimates for bid proposals, including technical query reviews, execution statements, and man-hour estimates. Raise technical queries to obtain missing information, clarify work scope, and ensure adherence to company procedures, specifications, standards, practices, and operational requirements. Prepare discipline engineering design basis, philosophies, and technical specifications as required. Participate in finalizing deliverables lists and deliverables, ensuring compliance with specifications and functional integrity. Attend project review meetings, vendor meetings, engineering meetings, and offshore site surveys when necessary. Assist the procurement team in acquiring discipline equipment, materials, and services, ensuring compliance with company objectives and procedures. Review vendor and subcontractor submittals, checking for compliance with project specifications and providing comments as needed. Keep the supervisor informed of all activities and concerns, including technical, budgetary, and manpower-related issues. Assist in providing input for actual, planning, and forecasting progress reports, including associated productivity. Support concerned parties in responding to the Company and other entities (*, certifying authorities, auditors, third parties) regarding their review and approval processes. Act as a resource for colleagues with less experience in the domain. Experience and Qualifications Candidates should possess 2-5 years of relevant experience in structural engineering tasks within a marine shipyard or similar heavy industrial environment. The role requires expertise in assessing structures for floating conditions, transportation logistics, lifting operations, onshore installation procedures, vessel deck layouts and modifications, and erection processes. Work Environment This position is based in Ras Al Khair, Eastern, Saudi Arabia, and is a full-time role within International Maritime Industries. The work involves collaboration with various internal departments and external entities to ensure project success and operational excellence.

2bc05249a08ddf7f.description: نبذة عن الوظيفة تبحث شركة سمامة للتشغيل والإدارة عن ميكانيكي كهرباء للانضمام إلى فريقها في جدة، مكة المكرمة. تتطلب هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل خبرة تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في المجال، وستكون مسؤولة عن تركيب وصيانة الأنظمة والمعدات الكهربائية لضمان كفاءة الأداء وسلامة التشغيل. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تركيب الآلات والمعدات والنظم الكهربائية المختلفة وفقاً للمخططات والمواصفات الفنية. فحص أداء المعدات بعد تركيبها ومعاينتها لضمان التقيد بالمعايير المطلوبة. إجراء الفحوصات الروتينية لقطع الغيار للتأكد من خلوها من الأضرار أو التلفيات الخطرة. تصليح وتحديث النظم الكهربائية لضمان استمرارية عملها بكفاءة. التحقيق في الأعطال وتشخيص المكونات المعيبة، ثم تصليحها أو استبدالها ومتابعة الأعمال المنجزة. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعمول بها في الشركة. المؤهلات والخبرات المطلوبة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 5 إلى 10 سنوات في مجال ميكانيكا الكهرباء. معرفة قوية بتركيب وصيانة النظم والمعدات الكهربائية. القدرة على قراءة وتفسير المخططات والمواصفات الفنية. مهارات ممتازة في تشخيص الأعطال وإصلاحها. متطلبات العمل القدرة على العمل بدوام كامل. الالتزام بمعايير الصحة والسلامة المهنية. موقع العمل تقع هذه الوظيفة في جدة، مكة المكرمة. معلومات إضافية الراتب لهذه الوظيفة سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال عملية المقابلة.

2bc3e11345ed0366.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة عن فني ميكانيكي معدات زراعية للانضمام إلى فريقها في صفوى، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على ضمان الأداء الأمثل للمعدات الزراعية من خلال التركيب، الفحص، التشخيص، والصيانة الدورية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في المجال. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية متابعة تركيب الأجهزة والمعدات الزراعية، والتأكد من إجراءات تشغيلها الصحيحة. تحديد القطع التبديلية اللازمة، ومطابقة مواصفاتها الفنية، والعمل على تأمينها. تنفيذ إجراءات استلام المعدات الزراعية لأغراض الخدمة والإصلاح. فحص وتشخيص أعطال المعدات الزراعية بدقة، ومتابعة عمليات إصلاحها. الالتزام بسياسات وإجراءات الصحة والسلامة والبيئة المعتمدة في جميع الأوقات. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في صيانة وإصلاح المعدات الزراعية. معرفة قوية بأنظمة ومكونات المعدات الزراعية المختلفة. القدرة على تشخيص الأعطال الفنية بدقة وفعالية. الالتزام بمعايير السلامة المهنية. موقع العمل ونوع الوظيفة هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل ومقرها في صفوى، المنطقة الشرقية. سيعمل الفني ضمن فريق متخصص لضمان استمرارية وكفاءة عمليات المعدات الزراعية. التقديم للمهتمين بالانضمام إلى مؤسسة أريس للتشغيل والصيانة، يرجى تقديم طلباتكم لهذه الفرصة في مجال صيانة المعدات الزراعية.

2bcd231c1c4afa37.description: About Fluor Corporation Fluor Corporation is dedicated to designing and building projects and careers. The company fosters a collaborative work environment that encourages innovative solutions and contributes to building a better world. This full-time Associate Designer I position is based in Saudi Arabia. Role Overview The Associate Designer I operates under detailed instructions and review, providing essential technical knowledge and performing specified work. This role contributes to Fluor's competitiveness by delivering quality services and technical competence. The primary purpose is to work on routine scope drawings, supporting the Design Area Lead or Lead. Key Responsibilities Prepare 2D Computer Aided Design (CAD) drawings of basic complexity. Interface closely with other discipline functions. Adhere to industry codes and standards, as well as department practices and procedures. Plan, organize, and execute assignments as directed. Perform other duties as assigned. Required Qualifications A combination of education and directly related experience totaling zero (0) years. Local requirements may necessitate additional or different qualifications. Ability to communicate effectively with various audiences, including management, coworkers, clients, vendors, contractors, and visitors. Job-related technical knowledge necessary to complete assigned tasks. Ability to learn and apply knowledge of applicable local, state/province, and federal/national statutes and guidelines. Ability to attend to detail and work efficiently within time constraints. Basic knowledge of 2D Computer Aided Design (CAD) systems and procedures. Knowledge of commercial availability and cost of materials. Practical field experience. Basic computer and software skills, including word processing, e-mail, spreadsheet, and electronic presentation programs.

2bdf2c197fb439f0.description: نبحث عن مسوق مبدع وطموح للانضمام إلى فريقنا والمساهمة في نمو علامتنا التجارية. ستكون مسؤولاً عن تطوير وتنفيذ استراتيجيات التسويق المبتكرة لتحقيق أهدافنا البيعية. انضم إلينا وكن جزءًا من بيئة عمل محفزة ومليئة بالتحديات. مهام ومسؤوليات المسوق: * تطوير وتنفيذ خطط تسويقية فعالة لزيادة الوعي بالعلامة التجارية وتعزيز المبيعات. * تحليل اتجاهات السوق والمنافسين لتحديد الفرص الجديدة وتطوير استراتيجيات مبتكرة. * إدارة الحملات التسويقية عبر مختلف القنوات الرقمية والتقليدية. * إنشاء محتوى تسويقي جذاب ومؤثر يتناسب مع الجمهور المستهدف. * قياس وتحليل أداء الحملات التسويقية وتقديم تقارير دورية للإدارة.

2be485712e7bda73.description: About the Role Qiddiya Investment Company is seeking a Senior Manager - Interface Management (MAS 654) to lead the identification, coordination, and resolution of interfaces across various projects, contractors, consultants, stakeholders, and operational entities. This full-time role is crucial for ensuring seamless integration between multiple workstreams, disciplines, and packages, aiming to mitigate risks, prevent conflicts, and support successful project delivery. Key Responsibilities Develop and implement the project Interface Management strategy, processes, and governance framework. Identify, document, track, and manage interfaces between infrastructure, utilities, transportation, buildings, and other project components. Lead interface coordination among consultants, contractors, authorities, operators, and internal project teams. Establish and maintain interface registers, action trackers, and reporting mechanisms. Facilitate interface workshops, coordination meetings, and technical reviews. Proactively identify interface risks, conflicts, and dependencies, ensuring timely resolution. Coordinate design, construction, and operational interfaces throughout the project lifecycle. Ensure alignment between project schedules, milestones, and interface requirements. Support change management processes and assess the impact of design and construction changes on interfacing packages. Monitor contractor compliance with interface management requirements and contractual obligations. Prepare interface reports, dashboards, and executive summaries for senior management. Promote collaboration and communication across multidisciplinary teams and stakeholders. Qualifications and Experience Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Project Management, or a related discipline. A minimum of 12 years of experience in project delivery, engineering management, infrastructure development, or interface management. Proven experience on large-scale infrastructure, transportation, utilities, mixed-use developments, or mega projects. Strong understanding of design management, project controls, construction management, and stakeholder coordination. Experience managing complex interfaces between multiple contractors, consultants, and project stakeholders. Professional certifications such as PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent are preferred. Application Process Candidates who meet the outlined requirements are encouraged to apply for this position. Salary details will be discussed during the interview process.

2bedd9bbf4cfc016.description: The KAUST Coral Restoration Initiative (KCRI) is a large-scale coral reef restoration program in the Red Sea in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia (KSA), begun in 2021 and funded by King Abdullah University of Science and Technology , a world-class graduate research university in Thuwal, Saudi Arabia on the Red Sea north of Jeddah, in partnership with NEOM, a region in northwest Saudi Arabia that is being sustainably developed from the ground up with the world’s most advanced technologies to redefine how people live, work, and play. The facility operates a network of Life Support Systems (LSS) supporting coral production, coral acclimation, seawater intake/filtration and used-water treatment and discharge, comprising pumps, valves, heat exchangers, filtration and disinfection equipment. Responsible for maintaining, troubleshooting, inspecting, and repairing electrical systems and equipment supporting the facility's Life Support Systems (LSS), including pumps, motors, control panels, filtration systems, and water-treatment equipment. Key Responsibilities Maintain and troubleshoot MCC, DB, MSDB, ESMDB, and SMDB electrical panels. Support connected equipment restart following normal and backup power transfers. Maintain and troubleshoot electrical motors, VFDs, starters, and pumps. Test motorized valve opening/closing commands and feedback signals. Maintain wiring and terminations for level sensors, flow meters, pressure transmitters, and water-quality sensors. Maintain and test emergency-stop circuits, interlocks, and safety systems. Perform preventive maintenance, including thermal imaging, torque checks, and insulation resistance testing. Maintain electrical single-line diagrams, panel schedules, and as-built documentation. Support emergency generator load testing and transfer switch maintenance. Complete CMMS work orders, breakdown reports, shift handover logs, and maintenance records. Follow SOPs, electrical safety requirements, HSE procedures, and report incidents or near misses. Requirements & Qualifications Diploma, ITI, or Trade Certificate in Electrical Engineering/Electrician trade, or equivalent practical experience. Minimum 8 years of hands-on electrical maintenance experience in industrial, utility, marine, or large infrastructure projects. Experience in LV power distribution, switchgear, MCC/DB panels, busbars, protection devices, motors, VFDs, and starters. 2b1770fc6326bda3.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة أركان الوطن للمقاولات عن مهندس كهروميكانيكي للانضمام إلى فريقها في خيبر، المدينة المنورة. يتولى شاغل هذه الوظيفة مسؤولية دراسة وتصميم الأنظمة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية، بالإضافة إلى الإشراف على الجوانب الفنية المتعلقة بالمواد وأنشطة الإنتاج والتركيب والصيانة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تصميم المعدات والأنظمة الكهروميكانيكية، وتحديد معايير الأداء والجودة المطلوبة. إدارة عمليات تركيب المعدات والأنظمة، بما في ذلك إعداد الجداول الزمنية وتقديرات التكلفة. الإشراف المباشر على أعمال صيانة المعدات وتصليحها لضمان استمرارية التشغيل. تطوير أساليب وإجراءات العمل ومواكبة أحدث التطورات التقنية في المجال. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة، والمشاركة في عرضها وتوضيحها، والعمل على حفظها في قاعدة البيانات المخصصة وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرة خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال الهندسة الكهروميكانيكية. معرفة قوية بمبادئ تصميم الأنظمة والمعدات الكهروميكانيكية. القدرة على إدارة مشاريع التركيب والصيانة بكفاءة. بيئة العمل هذه الوظيفة بدوام كامل وتقع في خيبر، المدينة المنورة. سيعمل المهندس الكهروميكانيكي ضمن فريق متخصص يهدف إلى تحقيق أعلى معايير الجودة والكفاءة في المشاريع. معلومات إضافية الراتب الخاص بهذا الدور سيتم تحديده بناءً على الخبرة والمؤهلات، وسيتم الإفصاح عنه خلال مراحل المقابلة.

2b2564a7741bea4b.description: نبذة عن الدور تبحث شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة عن أخصائي عمليات موارد بشرية للانضمام إلى فريقها في الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية. يركز هذا الدور على تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، بما في ذلك مراقبة الدوام، وإدارة الإجازات، وتحديث بيانات الموظفين، والتعامل مع استفساراتهم وشكواهم بمهنية عالية. يتطلب الدور خبرة تتراوح بين سنتين وخمس سنوات في مجال ذي صلة. المهام والمسؤوليات الرئيسية تنفيذ الإجراءات والأنظمة والنماذج الخاصة بمراقبة دوام موظفي الفروع وإجازاتهم بمختلف أنواعها، وتعديل النماذج عند الحاجة. تطبيق نظام مراقبة الحضور والتأكد من التزام الموظفين بأوقات الدوام الرسمي. تطبيق سياسات وإجراءات الإجازات السنوية والمرضية والطارئة وغيرها من الإجازات المحددة في سياسة العطل والإجازات المعتمدة. تطبيق إجراءات الترقيات والإعارة وانتهاء الخدمة، وتسجيل كافة وقوعات الموظفين وفقاً للأنظمة والإجراءات المعتمدة. التعامل مع شكاوى وملاحظات وطلبات واستفسارات الموظفين بطريقة مهنية، ورفع المشاكل إلى مدير الإدارة عند الضرورة. تحديث المعلومات المتعلقة بالموظفين وتزويد فريق خدمات الموظفين بها، من خلال تسجيل وتوثيق جميع البيانات مثل الترقيات والدورات التدريبية والأمور المتعلقة بالرواتب والامتيازات. إعداد الوثائق والتقارير المتخصصة المتعلقة بعمليات الموارد البشرية، وتقديم التوصيات والحلول المناسبة، وعرضها وحفظها في قاعدة البيانات الخاصة بها وفقاً للسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. المؤهلات والخبرات خبرة عملية تتراوح بين 2 إلى 5 سنوات في مجال عمليات الموارد البشرية أو دور مشابه. فهم جيد لأنظمة وإجراءات الموارد البشرية. القدرة على إعداد التقارير والوثائق المتخصصة. المهارات المطلوبة مهارات تواصل ممتازة للتعامل مع الموظفين والإدارة. القدرة على حل المشكلات والتعامل مع الشكاوى بفعالية. الدقة والاهتمام بالتفاصيل في تحديث البيانات وإعداد التقارير. الالتزام بالسياسات والإجراءات المعتمدة. بيئة العمل هذا الدور هو وظيفة بدوام كامل في مدينة الدمام، المنطقة الشرقية، ضمن فريق عمليات الموارد البشرية في شركة صناع المراتب للصناعة. تقديم الطلبات ندعو المهتمين ممن تنطبق عليهم المتطلبات المذكورة أعلاه لتقديم طلباتهم.

This role is responsible for developing, implementing, and continuously improving health and safety programs to ensure the wellbeing of employees, contractors, and stakeholders. The position requires 5-10 years of experience. Key Responsibilities Lead the development, implementation, and maintenance of project health and safety management systems in alignment with Maaden Corporate Health, Safety and Security requirements and the project HSE Management Plan. Ensure compliance with Saudi Arabian regulations, client requirements, company health and safety standards, and applicable Maaden Corporate Health, Safety and Security policies, standards, procedures, and Life-Saving Rules. Employees collaborate on projects aimed at developing innovative solutions within the mining and metals industries, contributing to the optimization of the mining life cycle on greenfield and brownfield facilities. 2b55f30e7ffea542.description: At Mirai, a Scopely Studio, we're passionate about creating engaging gaming experiences that delight millions of players worldwide. We are looking for a Senior Software Engineer, AI platform, who builds products and can see the platform inside them. You will write product features yourself, and you will turn what repeats across products into shared services and libraries the rest of the team builds on. The platform comes out of real product work, one product at a time, not ahead of it. Our AI Native Engineering team builds software for Scopely game teams and internal departments: tools that use large language models (LLMs) for bug triage, player feedback analysis, market and company research, and contract analytics, alongside direct-to-consumer web stores for Scopely games. Most of these tools repeat one pattern: connect a source system, build a trusted store, put an LLM or governed logic over it, and control who can see what. Today each product builds that pattern its own way, with its own model setup, its own access rules, and its own safety controls. This is a software engineering role, not an infrastructure role. Our DevOps and SRE engineers own clusters, pipelines, and cloud provisioning. If your recent work is mainly infrastructure with little product code, this is not the right fit. What you will do Build product features end to end on our internal AI tools, in TypeScript or Python, from design through production. Find what our products build separately and turn it into shared services and libraries: model access and spend, identity and permissions, retrieval, tool servers, and the controls around LLM calls. Move products onto them one at a time, without stopping delivery. Build MCP tool servers that expose company data to agents and chat tools, with the end user's permissions enforced before any data reaches the model. Help introduce relationship-based access control across products, so access rules are defined once and applied to both database queries and vector search. Standardize model access through our LLM gateway, so model choice, cost, and usage are set in one place rather than in each repository. Spread the safety patterns that live in one project each today to every product: prompt-injection handling, kill switches, sandboxed execution of generated code, and locked-down data access. Make the shared pieces easy to adopt: clear APIs, versioning, templates, and documentation another engineer can follow without asking you. Set the standard in code review, including for AI-assisted code, and mentor engineers through review, pairing, and design. Own incidents on what you build, and work with our DevOps engineers on how it is deployed and run. What we are looking for Six or more years building and running production software, including at least one shared service, library, or internal API that other engineers or teams depended on. Strong TypeScript and Node.js, and strong Python. Our services are split across both. Shipped LLM features to production: retrieval over embeddings, tool calling, structured output, and a way of checking output quality. Designed APIs or libraries other engineers build on, with real attention to versioning, compatibility, safe defaults, and documentation. Built multi-tenant or permission-sensitive systems, and knows where to enforce access so data never reaches a user, or a model, that should not see it. Treats model output and retrieved content as untrusted input. Solid system design: service boundaries, data modeling, failure handling, idempotency, and cost. Production experience on AWS, with infrastructure as code in Terraform or similar, enough to own how your services ship alongside DevOps. Writes tests as part of the work and treats CI checks as gates, not suggestions. Clear written and spoken English, and able to explain technical tradeoffs to product and business stakeholders. Uses AI coding tools and verifies their output. You understand, can prove, and own what you merge. The Stack Languages: TypeScript and Node.js, Python 3.11. Services: Express, FastAPI, Next.js AI: OpenAI models and embeddings, LangChain, access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced) Model Context Protocol (MCP) SDK, an internal LLM gateway built on LiteLLM over Amazon Bedrock Cloud and Delivery: AWS (EC2, ECS Fargate, Lambda, Data: PostgreSQL (Amazon RDS and Aurora), BigQuery, Amazon OpenSearch Serverless for vector search App Runner, S3, CloudFront), Terraform, GitLab and GitHub Identity and Access: Okta, OAuth 2.0 with PKCE, relationship-based access control with SpiceDB (designed, being introduced) Work Tracking : Jira, Confluence Nice to Have Relationship-based access control in practice, with SpiceDB, OpenFGA, or similar An LLM gateway such as LiteLLM or Amazon Bedrock, and evaluation or tracing tools such as Braintrust, Langfuse, or LangSmith An agent orchestration framework such as LangGraph A shared platform that served several teams or departments rather than one product Experience in games, or Arabic Mobile Phone Allowance Health Insurance Performance Bonus Relocation support where applicable

2b110dd37886678c.description: The role leads architectural and MEP fire and life safety compliance for commercial high-rise, hospital, mixed-use, industrial, warehouse and residential developments, from concept design through approvals, construction, testing and handover. You will coordinate with architects, MEP engineers, main contractors, clients, specialist subcontractors and consultant review teams. SCE Professional Engineer license is mandatory. Architectural Fire and Life Safety Develop and review fire and life safety strategies throughout the project lifecycle. Assess egress, occupant loads, travel distances, dead ends, exit discharge capacity, refuge provisions, horizontal exits and emergency access. MEP Fire Safety Integration Fire alarm and detection: Review addressable systems; smoke, heat, flame, aspirating, beam, duct, linear heat and gas detection; manual call points; audible/visual notification; voice evacuation; fire telephones/two-way emergency communication; zoning, monitoring, survivability and building-system interfaces. Cause-and-effect: Develop and verify matrices, operating sequences, input/output logic, alarm verification, supervisory/trouble signals, graphical annunciation and fire command centre controls. Coordinate elevators, access control, doors, dampers, smoke control, generators, gas shut-off, process equipment and BMS interfaces. Sprinklers and water-based suppression: Review hazard classification, design density/area, sprinkler types/temperature ratings, zoning, valves, hydraulic calculations, seismic restraints where applicable, concealed-space protection, obstructions and occupancy-specific arrangements. Standpipes, hydrants and hose reels: Coordinate wet/dry risers, landing valves, hose stations, yard hydrants, fire department connections/inlets, pressure-reducing devices, zoning, residual pressures, coverage, accessibility, signage and fire-fighting access. Special-hazard suppression: Review clean-agent, water-mist, foam, wet/dry-chemical, CO₂ and local-application systems for kitchens, data/electrical rooms, turbines, fuel areas, laboratories, archives and other risks. Address enclosure integrity, discharge alarms, abort functions, interlocks, personnel safety and agent storage. Fire-water storage and pumping: Verify demand/duration, tanks, fire/jockey pumps, duty/standby arrangements, suction/discharge piping, test headers, controllers, power supplies, pressure zoning, relief provisions, pump-room ventilation/drainage, monitoring, access and testing facilities. Emergency electrical systems: Review emergency/life-safety generators, ATS, UPS, emergency lighting, illuminated exit signs, fire alarm supplies, fire-pump feeds, smoke-control power, circuit segregation, selective coordination, fire-rated/mineral-insulated cables, protected routes, battery autonomy and electrical-room protection. Emergency communications: Coordinate public-address/voice alarms, fire-fighter telephones, radio enhancement where required, refuge communication, emergency control-room displays, elevator recall, fire-service lifts, door release, security integration and mass notification. Passive-fire interfaces: Coordinate tested fire-stopping for cables, conduits, pipes, ducts, busways, joints and mixed-service penetrations; rated shafts/enclosures; penetration labels; inspection access; insulation/movement compatibility; and maintenance of compartment ratings. Hazardous-material classification: Review inventories, quantities, physical/chemical hazards, storage/use, control areas, maximum allowable quantities, incompatibilities, occupancy classifications, separation distances and Safety Data Sheets for flammable/combustible liquids, gases, oxidizers, corrosives, toxics, reactive materials, aerosols and other regulated substances. Hazardous-material detection/controls: Coordinate combustible/toxic gas detection, oxygen-deficiency monitoring, leak detection, alarm set points, local/remote annunciation, emergency shut-off, isolation valves, excess-flow controls, process interlocks, emergency ventilation, standby power and fire alarm/BMS links. Storage/handling safeguards: Review approved cabinets/rooms, cylinder restraints, incompatible-material segregation, spill containment, drainage isolation, ventilation, bonding/grounding, explosion protection, pressure relief, purge systems, hazardous-area electrical classifications, emergency eyewash/showers and safe transfer/dispensing. Fuel, LPG and process hazards: Review tank capacities, day tanks, piping, pumps, loading/unloading, leak/gas detection, emergency isolation, ventilation, containment, separation, fire protection, vehicle-impact protection, shutdown logic and coordination with process safety studies. Emergency planning: Support fire/spill scenarios, pre-incident plans, emergency procedures, evacuation/shelter-in-place, responder information, hazard signage/labelling, decontamination, incident-control interfaces and authority coordination. Testing/acceptance: Define inspections, flushing, pressure/functional/integrated tests, alarm/control verification, smoke-control tests, pump acceptance, room-integrity tests, gas-detector calibration and suppression discharge tests where permitted, including records, training and handover requirements. Design Review, Coordination and BIM Review drawings, specifications, calculations, schedules, fire strategies, shop drawings, material submissions and method statements at each stage. Use BIM coordination/clash detection to resolve life-safety issues involving clearances, access, routing, compartment boundaries and maintainability. Maintain design comments, responsibility matrices, action trackers and closure evidence. Code Compliance and Authority Approvals Maintain project-specific code matrices covering the Bahrain Fire & Life Safety Code 2025 (effective 1 January 2026), Bahrain Civil Defence requirements, Saudi Building Code SBC 801, Saudi Civil Defense requirements, municipality conditions, client requirements and adopted NFPA standards. Apply project-adopted NFPA 101, 13, 72, 92 and 130, where applicable. Prepare/review fire strategy reports, authority drawings, calculations, compliance narratives, deviation requests, technical responses and resubmissions. Support Bahrain and Saudi Civil Defense submissions, inspections, permits, certificates, fire safety certification and relevant municipality/authority interfaces. Coordinate with the client’s authority having jurisdiction and close comments, approval conditions and design changes. 2ba2326317af8af1.description: Function: Product · 1 opening · Riyadh About SHIFTER SHIFTER is a Saudi B2B delivery orchestration platform. Write clear specs and acceptance criteria (user stories, API contracts, edge cases, failure states) that engineers can build from without guessing. Run delivery with the engineering team in two-week sprints: planning, refinement, acceptance and release, with a release you can name every sprint. Define and track product KPIs: time to integrate a merchant, order success rate, on-time delivery against SLA, wallet top-up rate and support tickets per 1,000 orders. Make pricing rules, SLA rules and settlement (T+5) configurable and auditable, together with the Pricing Specialist and finance. Keep the platform ready for regulatory and data requirements (Transport General Authority licensing, PDPL) with compliance before launch. What you bring 5+ years in product ownership or product management, including at least 3 years on a live B2B platform, marketplace, logistics, delivery, fintech or API product in Saudi Arabia or the GCC. You have shipped products to production yourself and can show, with numbers, the result of at least two releases you owned (adoption, conversion, retention, cost or time saved). Strong technical fluency: you read API documentation, design REST endpoints and webhooks with engineers, and write SQL to answer your own questions. Hands-on agile delivery with a backlog tool (Jira, Linear or similar); a Scrum Product Owner certification (PSPO or CSPO) is a plus, not a substitute for results. Experience with dispatch, order management, payments or wallet systems is a strong advantage. Fluent Arabic and English, written and spoken. Based in Riyadh, on site. What we offer Competitive base salary plus performance-linked incentives. A founding role with direct impact on the company's growth and a clear path to leadership. Medical insurance and benefits in line with Saudi Labour Law. A professional culture built on numbers, transparency and ownership. How to apply Apply with your CV and a short note covering three things: a link to or description of a live product you owned, your exact role in it, and one metric it moved with the before and after numbers. Coordinate technical, commercial, logistics and service requirements arising from activities within the territory with corporate teams. Provide sales forecasts, regular reporting and ongoing monitoring of strategic opportunities across the territory. What will help you succeed in this role? Bachelor’s degree in Business Administration, International Business, Sales, Marketing, or a related field is preferred. Proven experience in the fitness, wellness, sports equipment, flooring, or related industries, as well as in-depth knowledge of the fitness sector in the Middle East and Africa, including key market dynamics, major players, distribution models, and business culture across the region. Proven experience and established contacts with distributor networks and key accounts across multiple markets in the Middle East and Africa. Experience in establishing and tracking partners’ key performance indicators (KPIs), including revenue targets, inventory management, training, project portfolio development, and performance evaluations. Strong ability to identify, initiate, and develop strategic opportunities with key accounts. Strong project portfolio management skills, discipline in forecasting, and the ability to prepare CRM reports. Full professional proficiency in English. It would be even better if: You speak an additional language relevant to the region. You have an established network among distributors, gym operators, hotel groups, architects, designers, consultants, or equipment manufacturers in the Middle East and Africa. You have experience selling premium, technical, specification-led, or project-based products. What can you expect from us? The opportunity to lead the commercial development of a strategic international region. A premium product portfolio with strong differentiation in the fitness flooring market. The chance to work with leading fitness operators, franchise networks, and distributors across ME and Africa. A collaborative international team and direct exposure to senior leadership. A competitive compensation package including a fixed salary and a variable incentive plan linked to regional performance. If this sounds like the kind of challenge you’re looking for, and you’re ready to help build and grow PAVIGYM’s presence across ME & Africa, we’d love to hear from you. Let’s talk!
